steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the number of columns in the 384‑well plate, choose the starting tip column (1‑12), assign the P20 Multi‑GEN2 mount (the P300 will use the opposite mount), and upload the CSV file that lists each vial and its transfer volumes (see example CSV). The CSV defines the volume for each reagent, the source vial, and the destination columns.

steps.title: Pick up single tips with P300
steps.instruction: Load the P300 tip rack and pick up tips starting from the front of the user‑specified column. Within each column pick up the bottom tip first, then move upward (e.g., for column 11 the order is H11, G11, F11 …), and after a column is exhausted move left to the next column (e.g., H10, G10, …). Continue column‑wise then row‑wise until all required tips are collected.

steps.title: Transfer reagent from vials to 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: For each vial listed in the CSV (up to 12, one per column), aspirate the specified volume (X µL) from the vial in the 24‑well holder (starting at A1) and dispense that volume into every well of the corresponding column of the 96‑well plate using the tip picked in the previous step. Repeat this for each vial/column defined in the CSV.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate X µL from the current vial.
Dispense the aspirated volume into each well of the target column on the 96‑well plate.
Proceed to the next vial/column as defined in the CSV.

steps.title: Transfer from 96‑well to 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel on the mount defined earlier, aspirate the set volume for each column (as specified in the CSV) from the 96‑well plate and dispense it into the corresponding column of the 384‑well plate, reusing tips as much as possible. The number of destination columns is the value set in step 1.
